items.title: Compliance officer
items.description: Appoint a CO fluent in AML and submit their PHDF, together with relevant enclosures, as well as a Letter of engagement and CV . No SOW required

items.title: CGA Personal History Disclosure Form
items.description: Check document.Inspect all pages to ensure that there are no blank pages The applications must be filled in digitally. No forms shall be accepted where the customer has completed any section of the form handwritten. Check the forms and make sure there are no ink marks or handwritten notes.

items.title: Page 1: Application Number
items.description: Check document. Make sure that this is filled and the same as that shown on the portal

items.title: Page 1: Application Date
items.description: Check document. The application date must be filled and within six month`s of today`s date.

items.title: Page 1: Personal Information Section - Question 1: First Name
items.description: Check if information matches the passport.

items.title: Page 1: Personal Information Section - Question 2: Last Name
items.description: Check if information matches the passport.

items.title: Page 1: Personal Information Section - Question 6: DOB
items.description: Check if information matches the passport.

items.title: Page 1: Personal Information Section - Question 7 and 8: Former names
items.description: Check if applicant has submitted certified proof of previous names.

items.title: Page 1:Personal Information Section - Question 11
items.description: Must not be blank.

items.title: Page 1: Personal Information Section - Question 12
items.description: Must not be blank. personal email address

items.title: Page 2: Contact Details Section - Question 13
items.description: Must not be blank. Email address

items.title: Page 2: Contact Details Section - Question 14
items.description: Must not be blank. Mobile number

items.title: Page 2: Citizenship Section - Question 15
items.description: Check if matches the passport. Place of Birth must not be blank.

items.title: Page 2: Citizenship Section - Question 16
items.description: Must not be blank and check if matches the passport. Passport number must not be blank.

items.title: Page 2: Citizenship Section - Question 17
items.description: Check if matches the passport. Country of Issue must not be blank.

items.title: Page 2: Citizenship Section - Question 18
items.description: Check if matches the passport. Date of Issue must not be blank.

items.title: Page 2: Citizenship Section - Question 19
items.description: Check if matches the passport. Date of Expiry must not be blank.

items.title: Page 2: Citizenship Section - Question 20
items.description: Check if matches the passport. Nationality/ Citizenship

items.title: Page 5: Key Person Involvement Section - Question 27
items.description: Must be filled. If the Local Executive Director(official representative) is selected the name of the local service provider must be filled in. If other Key Function Holder is selected, then the function must be filled.

items.title: Page 5: Key Person Involvement Section - Question 28
items.description: If question 28 is filled then question 28.1. must be filled.

items.title: Page 5: Key Person Involvement Section - Question 30
items.description: Must be filled.

items.title: Page 5: Key Person Involvement Section - Question 31
items.description: Must be filled.

items.title: Page 7: Present Employment Section - Question 34 and 39
items.description: They must provide evidence of present employment.

items.title: Page 8: Source of Wealth Section - Question 41 - 42
items.description: Must be filled.

items.title: Page 8: Source of Wealth Section - Question 43
items.description: Must be filled. At least one must be selected, if 43.11 is selected then other Income must be filled.

items.title: Page 8: Question 44
items.description: If yes is selected, 44.1. must be filled.

items.title: Page 9: Declaration and Data Privacy
items.description: The document must contain the name and surname and digital signature of the person that filled the form on Page 9.

items.title: Passport
items.description: Check date and make sure the passport is not expired.Make sure that persons photo is clear and recognizable.

items.title: Criminal Record
items.description: Check the document and make sure it is in english language or if translated from another language, the translated document, must be certified. Check date and make sure the certificate is not expired (not older than 6 months). It must be submitted for every jurisdiction whereby the applicant resided for more than six months in the last two years.

items.title: Birth Certificate
items.description: Check the document and make sure it is in English Language or orginal document with translation. Both have to be certified. (In some cases we accept the Marriage Certificate)

items.title: Bank Statement /Reference Letter
items.description: Make sure that it is in the applicant name verifying their personal account.Check date and make sure the certificate is not expired (not older than 6 months).

items.title: Letter of appointment/ Engagement agreement as Key Person.
items.description: Check document. (mandatory for compliance officers)

items.title: Personal Gaming Authorisations from Other Jurisdictions
items.description: Certified true copies of any Gaming License issued in favor of the applicant in a personal capacity from any jurisdiction ( eg. UK Personal Management License)

items.title: Curriculum Vitae (CV)
items.description: Check document. (mandatory for compliance officers)

items.title: Source of Wealth for the UBO Only
items.description: The Source of Wealth must demonstrate the UBO`s financial standing and confirm their ability to operate and support the company.
